name: The Slaughtered Lamb
summary: Gnome warlocks from Ironforge now seek their training in Stormwind. The Slaughtered Lamb gives them a place to learn from human warlocks, while King Magni Bronzebeard keeps watch over dark practitioners at home.

sections.title: Exile and Scrutiny
sections.body: Before Gnomeregan fell, Khaz Modan's aspiring warlocks studied with tinker-mages and demonic scholars in the techno-city. Then disaster scattered those schools and drove the gnomes into exile. The survivors crowded into Ironforge's underground caverns, where King Magni Bronzebeard and the dwarven guard watch them. They cannot openly practice demonic arts or perform dangerous rituals, so senior instructors like Lago Blackwrench send students away.

sections.title: The Mage Quarter's Secret Cellar
sections.body: From Ironforge, gnome students travel south to the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. Twisting stone passages and stairs descend from the tavern's taproom to a hidden sanctum where human warlocks gather. Gakin the Darkbinder oversees them there. In its shadowed rooms, instructors can teach novices to summon and bind minor demons without drawing the city marshals' immediate anger.

sections.title: Growing Strain in the Shadows
sections.body: Stormwind's coven welcomes capable hands, though refugee novices bring new strain. Human mentors already risk discovery by the city's paladins and authorities. As more practitioners arrive from Khaz Modan, Gakin and his colleagues find their sanctuary growing crowded. The steady flow from the dwarven mountain could expose their hidden gathering. Yet neither the gnomes nor the human warlocks have an easier choice.

faq.q: Why can't gnome warlocks train in Ironforge?
faq.answer: King Magni Bronzebeard watches warlocks closely in Ironforge. Since Gnomeregan fell, displaced practitioners have no private academy, and summoning demons in the dwarven mountain risks discovery.

faq.q: Where were Khaz Modan warlocks trained before?
faq.answer: Before Gnomeregan fell, Khaz Modan warlocks trained with tinker-mages and demonic scholars in the techno-city. The disaster scattered those schools and sent survivors into exile.

Gakin the Darkbinder is a human warlock who oversees the hidden sanctum beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind. He teaches apprentices, including gnome novices from Ironforge, to summon and bind demons.
The Slaughtered Lamb is a tavern in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. Its cellar hides a gathering place for warlocks, out of the city authorities' sight.

faq.q: Why is Gakin frustrated with the newcomers?
faq.answer: Gakin fears that an influx of refugee gnomes will draw attention to Stormwind's hidden coven. Space and teachers are limited, and too much warlock activity could expose them to the authorities.
Lago Blackwrench is a gnome warlock trainer who lives in Ironforge's dark alleys. He sends promising novices to Stormwind to continue their training.

angles.text: For young Alliance warlocks, the journey carries them into a hidden network of practitioners across racial lines.
In exile, gnomes crowd into Ironforge and depend on human hospitality after losing their academies in Gnomeregan.
Ironforge's authorities watch demonic practice closely. Dwarf warlocks keep to the shadows and send their students elsewhere.
